title: Cashless claims: where the discharge delay really sits
takeaways: 3.26 crore health claims processed in FY25; ₹94,248 crore paid
8% of claims repudiated in FY25, down from 11%
Only 8% of patients got an instant cashless discharge
66.35% of claim value settled cashless in FY25
source_note: Sources: IRDAI Annual Report FY25; Lok Sabha data; LocalCircles 2026
